text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen. Tokai Teio 
makes her miraculous comeback and speaks 
to Twin Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I want to beat you more than anyone!" 
Twin Turbo is fired up after being 
recognized as a true rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She stepped onto the track ready to run 
her heart out and deliver a performance 
only she was capable of.
